name: Murdaloc
label: Quest
description: Agmond's battered remains lie in the Badlands, and a name is scrawled in the sandstone beside the dead hand: Murdaloc. Agmond's killer is to be put down…
intro: Agmond's battered remains lie in the Badlands, and a name is scrawled in the sandstone beside the dead hand: Murdaloc. Agmond's killer is to be put down, with word carried back to Prospector Ironband in Loch Modan.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Agmond's tracks lead from the west. It is easy to tell from the bloody smears across rock and sand that the dwarf crawled some distance.
Upon close inspection, the word "Murdaloc" is roughly scrawled in a patch of Badlands sandstone.
Scrawled next to Agmond's dead hand.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have news of Agmond's fate? Did you find him?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is sobering news, friend. But Agmond had a strong arm and a fierce hammer-swing, and his skull was as thick as they come! Although he was killed by those cursed troggs I'm sure he took a lot of them down with him.
